c74object.name: baco.curve~
c74object.description: Applies the static compression curve after the RMS calculation.

inlet.description: RMS signal used to calculate the static compression curve. Also accepts messages.

outlet.description: Static compression curve applied to the RMS signal

method.name: threshold
method.description: Sets the input level above which compression is applied

method.name: ratio
method.description: Sets the relationship between the input level above the threshold and the resulting output level

attribute.name: threshold
attribute.description: Sets the input level above which compression is applied

attribute.name: ratio
attribute.description: Sets the relationship between the input level above the threshold and the resulting output level
